SALT LAKE CITY--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 7, 2026--[PROG Holdings, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.progholdings.com%2F&esheet=54616805&newsitemid=20261007920593&lan=en-US&anchor=PROG+Holdings%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=911308764927323c6b3037cfc151dbbf) (NYSE:PRG), the fintech holding company for Progressive Leasing, Four Technologies, MoneyApp, and Purchasing Power, is scheduled to release financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 prior to the market open.


The Company has also scheduled a live webcast for October 28, 2026 at 8:30 A.M. ET to discuss its financial results for the third quarter of 2026. The webcast can be accessed via the below link, or through the[Events & Presentations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.progholdings.com%2Fevents-and-presentations&esheet=54616805&newsitemid=20261007920593&lan=en-US&anchor=Events+%26+Presentations&index=2&md5=c0d56ec37e2af16a2c0c8748ba311cb3) section of the PROG Holdings investor relations website,[https://investor.progholdings.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.progholdings.com&esheet=54616805&newsitemid=20261007920593&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.progholdings.com&index=3&md5=cba56fc8c0d7be210eafc474bcef9a43) .


Webcast Link:[https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/k64a98ta](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.media-server.com%2Fmmc%2Fp%2Fk64a98ta&esheet=54616805&newsitemid=20261007920593&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.media-server.com%2Fmmc%2Fp%2Fk64a98ta&index=4&md5=2b74ac4286b4500afa48bf2343ec430c)


***About PROG Holdings, Inc.***


*PROG Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:PRG) is a fintech holding company headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT, that provides inclusive, transparent and competitive payment options to consumers. The Company owns*[Progressive Leasing](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fprogleasing.com%2F&esheet=54616805&newsitemid=20261007920593&lan=en-US&anchor=Progressive+Leasing&index=5&md5=c11dc5beba77ba1c41087eed6d955e0d) *, a leading provider of e-commerce, app-based, and in-store point-of-sale lease-to-own solutions;*[Four Technologies](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fpaywithfour.com%2F&esheet=54616805&newsitemid=20261007920593&lan=en-US&anchor=Four+Technologies&index=6&md5=89a576ebddd3bc8272fbb96ffc16bdcd) *, a provider of Buy Now, Pay Later payment options through its platform, Four;*[MoneyApp](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcash.money.app&esheet=54616805&newsitemid=20261007920593&lan=en-US&anchor=MoneyApp&index=7&md5=f584a7d426955d6fcfcc4ff2986ad0ad) *, a provider of short-term liquidity solutions; and*[Purchasing Power](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.purchasingpower.com&esheet=54616805&newsitemid=20261007920593&lan=en-US&anchor=Purchasing+Power&index=8&md5=5a10a18a2a4e7fcb46eabc9379b09c62) , a *voluntary employee benefit program provider, allowing employees to purchase brand-name products through either automatic payroll deductions or allotments. More information on PROG Holdings' companies can be found at*[https://www.progholdings.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.progholdings.com&esheet=54616805&newsitemid=20261007920593&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.progholdings.com&index=9&md5=4ff69ba91b1c8114fefa8ebf5309b474) *.*
